advice.explanation: No candidate is eligible (status: no_solution), so no replacement is recommended. Reported motor failure is not a verified diagnosis; wiring, driver and power should be inspected first. tt-motor-148 ($1.60 catalog unit) and n20-gearmotor-100 ($3.20) are rejected because they are rated 3–6 V and the rover rail is 7.4 V, which exceeds their range. jga25-370-12v ($7.50 unit) is the only partial match: it is rated 6–12 V, so 7.4 V is nominally in range, but its ~2 A stall current needs a driver peak-rating check, and its geometry (62×25×25 mm, approximate) differs from the TT motor (70×22.5×18.8 mm), so appearance preservation is unverified. All costs are catalog list prices, not live quotes, and exclude shipping, tax and labor, so the total is unknown and budget compliance is not confirmed. Full-rover issues (board clearance/all_rules failures, disconnected copper islands, thermal model limited to 7.4 V) remain unresolved. Design previews are unverified, and this is not physical repair or purchase approval.
missing_info: Independent confirmation that the motor has failed (electrical and mechanical inspection of the motor, wiring, driver and power rail)
Driver peak current rating, to check against the JGA25's ~2 A stall current
Live quotes including shipping and tax, to confirm the total is under $30
Measured geometry and mounting clearance for the JGA25 versus the original TT motor, to confirm appearance preservation
Resolution of board clearance/all_rules failures and disconnected copper islands
Thermal validation at the actual 7.4 V rail (catalog thermal model covers only 7.4 V despite a 12 V label)
Confirmation that the shaft and wheel interface work with the chosen motor
Verification of the PWM interface with the actual driver
